body.statement: Conditional on effective compatibility density and \(\text{ass:effective-moving-remainder}\), suppose \(p_n(0)\to p_0\), \(c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0\), and \(\sup_{u\in C,j}|e_{n,j}(u)|\to0\) for every rational compact polytope \(C\subset\mathbb R^d\).  Apply CertGluePFL at a vanishing requested accuracy to the known experiment \(\mathfrak G_0(c_n)\), then transport the certified rule through Carter's positive-cell kernel.  The resulting rule, which uses \(c_n\) but not the unknown limit \(c\), has on each fixed \(C\) a semantic-label coverage deficit and separated-risk excess bounded by Carter's comparison error, \(\mathfrak b_0(\tau_n)\), the displayed moving-remainder charge, covariance and Gaussian-tail enclosures, semantic-union diameter inflation, and \(\rho_{\mathrm{led}}\).  The effective remainder modulus and certificate ledger compute a diagonal choice \(\tau_n\downarrow0\) for which this compact-set bound vanishes.  This statement is a compact-set transfer and does not by itself assert global honesty on every unbounded region \(D_{n,v}\).
body.justification: The finite slack list, compatibility subspace, and Gaussian band charge make offset adaptation a determinate uniform theorem rather than a promissory phrase.
body.gap: Kaido, Molinari, and Stoye calibrate drifting moment inequalities but do not transport a finite-label Gaussian minimax rule; Carter's kernel does not define or localize an active tangent arrangement.
body.consumer: The Job Corps rule handles known root-\(n\) drifts in the capacity, generalized-inverse, and endpoint-program faces while charging every observation falling near one of the explicitly enumerated active boundaries.

obligation.what_is_open: After the effective diagonal is supplied, construct one transferred rule and propagate comparison, boundary, covariance, tail, semantic-union, and ledger charges with exact constants.
obligation.obstruction: The effective remainder assumption fixes the noncomputable-diagonal defect, but the quantitative experiment-comparison lemma is absent and compact boundary localization alone does not prove global honesty.
obligation.attempted: The exact slack decomposition and univariate Gaussian band bound isolate every sign disagreement on a compact set.
obligation.partial_result: If \(|e_{n,j}(u)|<\tau\) and \(|c_{n,j}+a_j'u|>\tau\), then \(\zeta_{n,j}(u)\) and \(c_{n,j}+a_j'u\) have the same sign.  Also \(a_j'W_0\) is univariate normal with variance \(a_j'\Sigma_0a_j>0\), so its density is bounded by \(\{2\pi a_j'\Sigma_0a_j\}^{-1/2}\).  A union bound therefore gives the charged probability \(\mathfrak b_0(\tau)\).  This proves compact boundary localization; it does not construct one globally honest rule on all unbounded finite-sample regions.
